lines.t: I looked at the blueprint of who I used to be
Tore it down
Starting over
From the floor
I was living in a frame that was built to break
Counting every error and the same mistake
Trying to fix a foundation made of dust and sand
Building up a castle with a trembling hand
Self-reliant, defiant, caught up in the stress
Trying to find a victory in all the mess
Every anchor was slipping, every rope was torn
Living like a shadow that was never born
I was running on empty, fighting with my past
Trying to make a moment that would never last
Look, then the hammer hit the stone, had to strip the floor
Wipe the whole slate clean, lock the basement door
No more measuring my life by the worldly scale
No more fighting in the dark just to watch me fail
I surrendered the supply, gave the crown away
Traded in the midnight for a brand new day
Every syllable snapping like a spark in the dark
Got the spirit in the lungs, leaving behind the mark
Of a dead man walking in a worn out suit
Now I'm standing on the bedrock, bearing real fruit
My foundation got recessed, stepping out the shadow
No more running blind in an endless battle
Tore the old house down to the bedrock stone
Now I'm standing on the rock and I'm not alone
Bedrock stone
Standing on the rock and I'm not alone
They keep looking for the girl that they used to know
The one stuck in the stone with nowhere to go
The one trapped in her head, double thinking every move
Trying to prove something that she didn't have to prove
Pass the word to the past, that girl is dead
There's a new creation standing in her place instead
Old things passed away, everything is made new
Got a brand new heart and a whole new view
You can call it a rebirth, call it a reset
I'm a product of a grace that I won't forget
Not the same person walking in the old way dust
I'm a vessel made of honor that is filled with trust
Filled with trust
Old life gone, old metrics erased
Same face, same voice, but a brand new base
All things past, everything new
One, two, three, go
My foundation got reset, stepping out the shadow
No more running blind in an endless battle
Tore the old house down to the bedrock stone
Now I'm standing on the rock and I'm not alone
Brand new life
I'm standing on the rock and I'm not alone
Not who I was
A new creation
Firm foundation
